verdict.rationale: Rootly documents generating API keys in Organization Settings, and says Global API Keys are assigned On-Call and Incident Response roles when generated. That points to role-based scoping of credentials, but the evidence does not show how granular or least-privilege those roles can be. Missing for 10: documented custom or narrowed permission scopes per key, read-only or per-resource restrictions, agent-specific credential guidance (e.g. for the MCP server), key expiry/rotation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: To generate a new API key, navigate to: **Organization dropdown** > **Organization Settings** > **API Keys > Generate New API Key**.
Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role when they’re generated.
